cases.name: Integration self-rotating client secret + GitHub Actions OIDC
cases.notes: GitHub label matches the reporter-selected Product Area in the issue form, so it is not independent evidence. Part 1 (rotate-secret for public integrations / sentry-apps) is managed under Developer Settings > Custom Integrations; nearest historical example #125705 (Sentry App webhooks) is Developer Settings. Part 2 (GitHub Actions OIDC for release uploads) is auth-token behavior; Settings - Auth is also a candidate. Similar older issues (#76660 client secret, #71744 auth tokens) used the retired APIs label. Two requests in one issue; may need splitting.
